description: This file implements classes and functions for recording, serializing, and replaying Python execution states, including module access patterns, execution context, and variable states, primarily for debugging and testing purposes.

classes.name: ModuleRecord
classes.description: Tracks module access patterns and attribute usage during execution.

classes.name: DummyModule
classes.description: A lightweight substitute for a module used during replay to mimic module attributes.

classes.name: ExecutionRecord
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the execution state, including code, globals, locals, and builtins, with serialization support.

classes.name: ExecutionRecorder
classes.description: Records variable states and module access during execution, capable of producing an ExecutionRecord.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Serializes the execution state to a file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Deserializes an execution state from a file.

methods.name: add_local_var
methods.description: Adds a local variable or module to the recorder.

methods.name: add_global_var
methods.description: Adds a global variable or module to the recorder.

methods.name: add_local_mod
methods.description: Adds a local module as a global variable.

methods.name: record_module_access
methods.description: Records access to a module's attribute.

methods.name: get_record
methods.description: Generates an ExecutionRecord representing the current state.

methods.name: _add_mod
methods.description: Adds a module to the internal module record mapping.

methods.name: _resolve_modules
methods.description: Resolves module records into dummy modules for serialization.
